response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as record_count, AVG(rebrate / feerate) as avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009 AND feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebrate IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: High fee-rate band using 0.0009 as cutoff means feerate >= 0.0009 (cutoff value is included as the lower bound)

alternatives.interpretation: If high fee-rate band means strictly above the cutoff (exclusive boundary)
